Build comparison: before and after

Main at b274ddc (before) and branch claude/build-comparison-ux-d98b9e (after), Luca profile, weapon Current, 1600 px (the app at 135% zoom) and 412 px phone width.

Inventory: weapon vs weapon

Before: tick two weapons, compare their pick (scored now) with the other one's stale run (+1.4 that is only staleness). After: every weapon on one damage scale (your builds, pick, best of the run), and a head to head with a verdict, the weapons' own stats, a check that flags the Coalescence difference, stale runs, and damage per attack.

Inventory: compare by "best of yours"

The same two weapons by your own builds: Current 1,353 vs the reroll's In game 1,164. Same ceiling, so the difference is in the builds.

Results against your build

Before: "Differences against" follows whichever My builds tab was selected; cards show score from the old run next to damage. After: "Compare with" is its own choice (default: the pick), a table with the gain, the slots that change and skills gained/lost, the cheapest upgrade on top, and a row opens its swaps in place.

Results: fewest changes first

Sorted by how many pieces you would craft.

Results: card view

Each card gets the same one-line summary of what changes, and the swaps open inside the card.

"Compare" from a result

Before: the button opens My builds at the top; the comparison is about 4,300 px further down, against whichever build was selected. After: "Side by side in Compare" (or the tray) opens the Compare tab.

Compare tab across weapons, under the baseline's conditions

Builds of two weapons side by side, all scored under In game's conditions.

The compare tray

Builds collected with the ⇄ buttons stay at the bottom of every tab until you open the comparison.

My builds

The selected build is compared with the weapon's baseline by default; "vs ..." jumps down to the comparison. New: Try a change, ⇄ Compare.

Try a change: a draft next to In game

A draft of In game with run build 1's weapon decorations: 1,327 (+38). Each changed row says what that change alone is worth; Apply / Keep / Discard; one-piece upgrades from the last run.

Units: attack as true raw, element as in game

Before: "1118 display (233 true)", "ATK 315 1510 display", "Dragon 58 576 display". After: 233, ATK 315, Dragon 576.

Review tab

The weapon line shows true raw only.
